items.text: Kosodi kanen, kepupu ekabaka Kesekia, kocil inapeneke, konap epuko, koloma togo loka EJAKAIT.
Kijuka Eliakim, loapolokinit ekal, ka Sebuna ekewadikan, ka imakio luka isasedotin, konapitos ipukoi, mama ejai Isaia enabi okoku loka Amos.
Kotemasi ŋes atiar, “Inera Kesekia kwanata ebe, Apaaran na erai apaaran naka iean, naka aitoronio, ka naka amoromoroo: naarai adol idwe aurio, emamei da agogoŋ nakaidoun.

Motoko iirari EJAKAIT Ekonideke akiro kere nuka Rabasake, loejukuni ekabaka loka Asuria ejakaitike amoromor Edeke lokajaran, ka aitoron akiro nuapupu EJAKAIT Ekonideke: aso kitonyou ailipikon kanuka aatoŋot naedeun.”
Kopotu do ikejaanakinak luka ekabaka Kesekia neejai Isaia,
Kotema Isaia kes atiar, “Kolimokis ejakaitikus kwanata ebe, ‘Inera EJAKAIT kwanata ebe, Sirikiyoŋ akiro nuipup, nukamoromorooto eoŋ ikejaanakinak luka ekabaka loka Asuria.
Koany, ebwaikin emoyo tomake, epupuni ŋesi eemut, eboŋori bukee; ebirokini eoŋ da ŋes kekilen akwapuke.’’’
Kobono do Rabasake, kodum ekabaka loka Asuria ejiosi ka Libuna: naarai abu kopupunite ebe abono ŋesi koLakis.
Kepupu inerai nuka Tiraka eka baka loko Etiopia ebe, “Koany, alomu aitiii jo”: kiyakik bobo ŋesi Kesekia ikiyakia ebe,
“Itemarete Kesekia ekabaka loka Yuda kwanata ebe, ‘Kinyek Edekekon loimuno aiŋal jo ebe, Mam Yerusalem ijaikinio akan naka ekabaka loka Asuria.
Koany, ipupunit ijo nueswamakis ikabakan luka Asuria akwapin kere, amudianarete kes eut: do konyet ijo kiyuunio?
Apotu kereka idekesio luka atekerin koyuununete kes, nuamudianarete lukapapaaka, Gosan, ka Karan, ka Resep, ka idwe luka Eden luajaas Telasar?
Ai bo ejai ekabaka loka Kamat, ka ekabaka loka Arupad, ka ekabaka loka ere loka Separabaim, loka Kena, ka Iba da?’”
Kiiau Kesekia ebalua kakan naka ikiyakia, kosiom; kolot Kesekia togo loka EJAKAIT, kopesia kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT.
Kilip Kesekia kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT, kobala ebe, “Wu EJAKAIT, Edeke loka Isirael, loiboie kokerubin, ijo ŋes Edeke, ijo bon, loka ajakanuto kere nuka akwap; ijo kolo isubi akuj ka akwap.
Kitoik akonikit, wu EJAKAIT, kiira; kokweny, wu EJAKAIT, koany; kopup akiro nuka Senakerib, nueiuku ŋesi amoromoroo Edeke lokaiaran.
Abeit, wu EJAKAIT, apotu ikabakan luka Asuria komudiasi atekerin ka akeeekwapin,
Apotu kocakasi idekesiokee akim: naarai mam keraas idekesio, konye aswam naka akanin nuka ituŋa, ikito ka amor; ŋes kemudiarere ŋes.
Aso do, wu EJAKAIT Ekosideke, kenainait, kitaiarai sio kakanike, tetere ejenunete ajakanuto kere nuka akwap ebe ijo ŋes EJAKAIT Edeke, ijo bon ba.”
Kosodi Isaia okoku loka Amos aiiukakin Kesekia ebe, “Inera kwanata EJAKAIT, Edeke loka Isirael ebe, Naarai ilip eoŋ asurokin Senakerib ekabaka loka Asuria, eira,
Na ŋes akirot naener EJAKAIT mama ejai ŋesi ebe:
“Na ŋes eraun aanyunet neijai: okaru lo inyamete yenebwaŋuni bon, okaru lokiareit yenitoeuni kaii; okaru lokiwuniet koyeata, kodwenya, kiraata imanikoria luka emusabibu, konyama araitoke.
Edupi aatoŋot naideuni naabu koku kokek loka Yuda alias kwap, kota araito kokuiu,
Naarai elomari aatoŋot koYerusalem, luekuete da komoru Sion: itodolikini ŋun adunyanut naka EJAKAIT,
“Kanuka nun inera kwanata EJAKAIT nuka ekabaka loka Asuria ebe, Mam edoluni ore lo, karaida agumakin emal, karaida adolokin kebuku, karaida aitutu etut asurokinia ŋes.
Ebala EJAKAIT ebe, Orot lokelomunia, nopenol ebonoria, ido mam edoluni ore lo.
Naarai egaŋi eoŋ ere lo aitaiar, kanukan, ido kanuka ekakejaanakinan Daudi.”
Kosodi kanen, akuare ŋin; koloma emalaika loka EJAKAIT oidukurun luka Iyasurian, kodany ilukumin akwatat ka akaisakanykauni ka lukany: kenyout ituŋa tupuruc sek, koany, koraas kere ikatwak.
Kosodi Senakerib ekabaka loka Asuria anyoun, kolot, kobono, kiboikin Ninebe.
Kosodi kanen, emai ŋesi kotogo loka Nisurok ekedeke, koarata Aduram-melek ka Sareser ŋes kekileŋ: kokereasi akwap naka Ararat. Kirum Esar-kadon okokuke aiboisike.
